case_number: 2024 INSC 92; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.704 of 2024 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) No.10047 of 2023)
summary: Bail denial in UAPA terrorism case; charges include Sections 17,18,19 UAPA, IPC sections 124A,153A,153B,120B; alleged Khalistan-related terrorist activities; prima facie evidence from co-accused disclosure statements; travel to Srinagar to procure weapons; bail denied under UAPA Section 43D(5); court finds reasonable grounds to believe accusation; protected witness testimony; NIA case RC.19/2020/NIA/DLI.
final_judgment: Bail application rejected; appeal dismissed; High Court order upholding bail denial confirmed.
